display.role: headlines, cover titles, pull-quotes only, never below 24px, italic for editorial tone

mono.role: hex values, measurements, eyebrows, folio numbers, anything that reads as data

brandmark.construction: single continuous stroke shaped like an M; where the two diagonals cross the mid-line a crossbar reveals an A in the valley
brandmark.primary: monogram + full name stacked, min 200px digital / 45mm print
brandmark.secondary: monogram + lowercase domain wordmark 'adibwafi.com', min 140px digital / 32mm print
brandmark.clearspaceUnit: u = width of one monogram stroke at the size in use

supergraphic.name: Frame & Grid
supergraphic.frame: open corner brackets in accent color, viewfinder-derived
supergraphic.grid: faint dot lattice in structural color, low opacity, codebase-baseline-derived
supergraphic.rule: always used as a pair; never brackets alone on a busy photo; grid never at full opacity
